A '''medical bandage patch''' was a small patch used to bandage the incision made during a surgical operation. It was used by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].

==History==
[[File:MedicalBandagePatch-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The patch used on [[Tup/Legends|Tup]].]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date Legends">{{TCWdates|602}}</ref> [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] [[AZI-345211896246498721347/Legends|AZI-3]] used one of these patches during the extraction of an [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chip]] from the [[Brain/Legends|brain]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Tup/Legends|Tup]]. After the incision was made and the bandage put in place, AZ-3 was able to suck the biochip directly from the brain, straight through the blue [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] in the center of the patch to a container.<ref name="Conspiracy" />

The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] later performed the same operation on [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] with the same result. The patch was later removed; no trace of the incision was underneath.<ref name="Fugitive">{{TCW|Fugitive}}</ref>
